resources.string: Choose folders or selected photos, GIFs and videos. Media is indexed automatically and stays with its original storage provider.
Add named folders or selected-media collections to this profile, or create another profile in SAO.
Generates tags and text offline. Images include animations; animation counts update after format checks. GIFs and videos use one frame. Description searches names, tags and detected text.
Found so far: %1$d images (%2$d animated) · %3$d videos
Match descriptions such as “a happy person wearing a blue shirt” using an image and text model. This is separate from tags and OCR.

Download %1$d MB of verified model files into your selected folder? This download can use mobile data. Afterward, indexing and Context searches run entirely on this device. Save the library to apply Context search.
CLIP model ready. Save the library to apply your search setting.
Waiting for battery, storage or network · %1$d / %2$d MB
Could not prepare this model. Check folder access and that files match the selected model. Choose a writable folder on this device; use an empty folder if existing files do not match.
Choose a model folder, then download once or reuse its existing model files.
Use Context search for this library
%1$d collections unavailable. Restore access or rescan to retry.
Rescan folders to retry failed files.
Scan %1$s again and regenerate its automatic labels and text. Your corrections and original files are preserved.
Save this library to start indexing.
Indexing paused. Existing indexed files remain available.
Scanning folders… %1$d files found; %2$d awaiting analysis.
%1$s %2$d files could not be analyzed; %3$d folders unavailable. Rescan to retry; choose a folder again to restore access.
Checks for new files when you use this source, up to every five minutes. Rescan checks now. Indexing waits when battery or storage is low.
Enter a name and add at least one readable collection.
Could not read that folder. Choose it again using the system picker.
Could not read or save this library. Your original files were not changed.
Tap a file to correct its title, tags, description or detected text. Corrections stay in this extension and survive rescans.

Tags and emoji (comma or line separated)
Automatic analysis unavailable; you can still enter metadata.
ViT-B-32__openai, the same default model as Immich. Larger download and memory use.
Same OpenAI CLIP family with quantized weights. About 75% smaller download and lower weight memory; rankings can differ. Changing models rebuilds Context only. Labels, OCR and corrections stay.
Choose a dedicated folder on this device. Downloaded files stay there after uninstalling; select the same folder after reinstalling to reuse them.
Using an earlier internal download. Choose a folder to move it outside the app without downloading again.
Grant access to a folder and its subfolders. New supported files are discovered when this source is used.
Choose individual photos and videos, including Google Photos when available. Android does not grant access to a whole cloud album. For a whole local collection, use Add whole folder below.
Choose individual images and videos from a document provider. Access is retained for background indexing. For a whole collection, use Add whole folder below.
Selected items · add more media to expand this collection
